source_conflicts: Spelling: HTML 'practice/practicing/willfully/enroll/authorized' vs PDF 'practise/practising/wilfully/enrol/authorised' throughout (30+ occurrences); HTML spelling kept.
Schedules: PDF prints three Schedules (pp. VI/19-VI/26); HTML prints only the word 'Schedules'. Not transcribed.
Marginal headings: PDF prints a marginal note for every rule of s.31 and for ss.25(2), 29(2); HTML has none. Added to the tree from the PDF with heading_source.
s.43 marker: HTML '[2 3, Law 23 of 1978]' and PDF '[§§ 2 & 3, Law 23 of 1978]' agree; neither chain header lists that Law.
PDF text layer is itself OCR-damaged ('Regis trar- Gene ral', 'fst', 'thc', 'authurized', 'transmuted', 'war rani'); used for reading, never for text.

HTML defects corrected against the PDF: marginal notes glued into ss.22(1), 29(1), 31 (opening), rules (2), (16)(b), (36), (36)(a), 40(3); '(b3)' for '(b)' in s.28(1); heading typos in ss.3, 13, 14, 18, 20, 21, 29, 38; section text repeating subsection (1) in ss.16, 18.
statute_note: Principal source selected: the LankaLaw consolidated HTML (data/legal-sources/library/statutes/HTML/1-1907-notaries-ordinance.html), whose chain header runs to Act No. 12 of 2005; parsed with build_canonical_statutes.py --source-id SRC014 (byte-identical to the committed canonical tree), then hand-corrected. Other sources inspected: the RGD consolidated PDF (Cap. 110, 22 pp, chain to Law 20 of 1976, OCR-grade text layer) read section by section as the verification source; the parsed/ LLM extraction not used; Government Printer PDFs of Acts 47 of 2011, 13 of 2013 and 6 of 2024 (text layers, parsed with parse_amendment_pdf.py, then hand-corrected); the RGD scan of Act 31 of 2022 (no text layer, OCR to a sidecar and proof-read against all 22 rendered pages; parse_amendment_pdf.py found no sections so the tree was built by hand); LankaLaw HTML of Laws 24 of 1973 and 20 of 1976 and of the Increase of Fines Act 12 of 2005 (none carries the subscription banner; the 12 of 2005 page omits its Schedules); the 1951 scan of Act 6 of 1951 (title page read only). Consolidation cutoff: Act No. 12 of 2005 (HTML). Review performed: one worker, reduced Step 7: full section list (43 sections: 1-14, 16-43, 4A) and headings read against the PDF; both definitions read; last provision of the five longest sections (31, 41, 21, 34, 32) read word for word; ss.2, 3, 12, 13, 27, 28, 31 (rules 3-10, 14-17, 20, 26-30, 36), 34, 38, 39, 41, 43 read in both editions; a two-way word diff between the tree and the PDF body checked. Amendment coverage: 20 reconciliation rows (18 RUBRIK instruments, Act 6 of 2024, Law 23 of 1978). Everything to 12 of 2005 is in the baseline; Acts 47/2011, 13/2013, 31/2022 and 6/2024 applied in date order, 63 operations applied with text_before_amendment kept, 7 not applied and 2 no-ops, all in the tree's applied_amendments_log. Nothing was applied twice. OCR and structural weaknesses: Act 31 of 2022 rests on a single OCR reading corrected by eye (51 listed corrections; Form E low confidence); the applied 2022 and 2024 wording is therefore unverified against any text-layer copy for 2022. The Schedules (First, Second, Third) are not in the tree; the PDF holds them at the 1976 cutoff and four held Acts amend Second Schedule forms that could not be applied. Rule (30) of s.31 stays at baseline because 31 of 2022 quotes words ('registered') the baseline does not contain, which also blocks 6 of 2024 s.3(10). The proviso to rule (17) is kept at rule level pending a lawyer's placement. Spelling differs systematically between the two editions. Missing sources: the eleven pre-1951 Ordinances in the chain, Law 23 of 1978, and the Second Schedule of Act 12 of 2005 are not held; Form E and Form B1 of 31 of 2022 could only be read from the scan. Unresolved questions: whether s.12(3) ever existed in the consolidated text that Act 31 of 2022 s.3(3) repeals; the exact reading of 'as Juvanis' in Form E; the intended fate of the rule (17) proviso; whether 6 of 2024 s.3(5)(a) (identical words) is a misprint. Registry: SRC014 title 'Notaries Ordinance' agrees with s.1; the curriculum list names 47/2011, 13/2013, 31/2022 and the early Ordinances, all reconciled above; SRC016 (6 of 2024) is held in the registry but absent from the RUBRIK entry. Lawyer-verification status: unverified. Pipeline status needs_structural_review because the Schedules are not transcribed and nine operations from held Acts could not be applied (7 not applied, 2 no-ops).
